events.text: Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Everton 1, Crystal Palace 0. Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Harrison Armstrong.
